color.note: Two themes, light and dark, as in the app. Neutral greys with one set of three priority colors that stay the same in both themes.

tokens.name: page
tokens.usage: Background of every screen and of the add bar.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Task titles, the screen title and the check box outline, on page, panel and aim.

tokens.name: quiet
tokens.usage: Counts, notes, the idle mode dot, the bin icon and placeholders, on page and aim. In light it reads 4.4:1 on page, a hair under 4.5; the source value is kept.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between things. The app draws almost none, so use it sparingly.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Floating notes such as the undo pill.

tokens.name: aim
tokens.usage: A row that is targeted, being dragged or dropped into, and the rename side of a swipe. Ink reads on it.

tokens.name: priority-high
tokens.usage: High priority dot, the mode dot when priority mode is on, and the remove side of a swipe. Not for text; white labels (`on-accent`) on it read 4.5:1 or better.

tokens.name: priority-medium
tokens.usage: Medium priority dot. A mark only, never text; it is told apart by its place in the list order as well as its color.

tokens.name: priority-low
tokens.usage: Low priority dot. A mark only, never text.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on priority-high, as in the remove side of a swipe.

families.mono: "Roboto Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: title
styles.usage: The screen title, always lowercase, next to a segment count.

styles.name: title-small
styles.usage: Small headings inside sheets and dialogs.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Task titles and everything a person types.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Quiet buttons: clear, undo, restore, delete.

styles.name: note
styles.usage: Progress, the bin count and the pill message.

styles.name: target
styles.usage: The target line above the add field, the same size as the clear button beside it.

spacing.note: One scale on a 4px grid, and named sizes for every mark. In the app each is a dp value in ui/theme/Space.kt; screens use these names and write no numbers of their own.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: The smallest step. Side padding of rows and bars, gap between a small number and what is beside it, gap between seven-segment digits.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of the title bar, gap between a count and the control beside it.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of a title inside a row and of bin entries, gap between the screen title and its count.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: The gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: One level of indent.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: The largest step, for gaps between whole groups.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Left edge of text on every screen: titles, the add field's text, the target line, bin entries, the undo pill's left end.

tokens.name: row-pad
tokens.usage: Side padding of every row and bar. The control at the right edge fills the rest of its touch slot, which is why the edge looks wider.

tokens.name: indent
tokens.usage: How far each level of subtask moves right, dot and text together. Four levels at most (main, sub, sub-sub, sub-sub-sub), so the deepest dot sits 60px in.

tokens.name: touch
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of anything tappable, and the height of every row.

tokens.name: end-row
tokens.usage: The invisible row at the end of the list that catches drops: a task and a half.

tokens.name: time-column
tokens.usage: Width reserved for the time at the left of an event, so every title lines up.

tokens.name: fab
tokens.usage: The round add button in the agenda.

tokens.name: icon
tokens.usage: Drawn icons, inside a touch square.

tokens.name: check
tokens.usage: The check box.

tokens.name: dot
tokens.usage: Diameter of every priority dot. All levels are the same size; only color tells them apart.

tokens.name: dot-lane
tokens.usage: Width of the touchable lane around a priority dot (touch tall).

tokens.name: mode-dot
tokens.usage: Diameter of the mode dot.

tokens.name: stroke-thin
tokens.usage: Outlines of icons, the check box, the empty priority ring.

tokens.name: stroke-thick
tokens.usage: The tick in the check box and the drop line.

tokens.name: digit-width
tokens.usage: One seven-segment digit.

tokens.name: digit-height
tokens.usage: One seven-segment digit; the second, fainter count is drawn at the same size.

tokens.name: digit-bar
tokens.usage: Thickness of one bar of a digit.

tokens.name: digit-gap
tokens.usage: Space between digits.

tokens.name: radius-check
tokens.usage: The check box.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: The undo pill.

shadow.note: The app has no shadows at rest. The one exception is the row lifted by a long press.

tokens.name: lift
tokens.usage: A row being dragged, shown at 92% opacity.
